Digest appends the survey fold + verify plan next; Decide appends decisions + the adopted/perfected task slate; Review closes the story.

Execute wave 12 of the studio-claude-chat initiative: "Claude's hands + the workday" — the 8 pre-filed bp children of epic task-9f81108b31d1d947 (scc-w12-capabilities, scc-w12-wire-harness, scc-w12-mcp-probe, scc-w12-mcp-loopback, scc-w12-native-chips, scc-w12-needs-you, scc-w12-notify, scc-w12-fork-probe). Goal: protect the moat (a %Capabilities{} struct with a no-tax matrix test proving Claude renders identically pre/post + a wire-contract harness: fixture replay per PR, nightly real-binary smoke, pinned CLI version), give Claude hands over Barkpark (MCP loopback via --mcp-config -> bp mcp serve with a session-scoped token through the grants seam, probe gates build; then task/paper/search results as deep-linked chips), and build the workday shell (needs-you/finished-while-away sidebar inbox strip, then email notifications via the existing Postfix/DKIM relay with deep links). Plus the fork-session probe: persist message.uuid, probe --resume+--fork-session and message-granular resumeSessionAt; deliverable is a written verdict, not UI. Demo sentence the wave must make true: I asked the chat to plan a feature; it wrote the Paper, filed the tasks, launched the epic-cycle, I watched the phases breathe in the rail — and it pinged me when it needed me.

The finished experience: the chat stops being a transcript viewer and becomes a coworker with hands and a pulse. You ask it to plan a feature; through its own MCP loopback into Barkpark it writes the Paper, files the tasks, launches the epic-cycle; the wave-11 rail shows the phases breathing; the sidebar's needs-you strip surfaces every pending question/plan/approval across ALL sessions plus what finished while you were away; and when you walk away, an email with a deep link brings you back to the exact card. Underneath, none of this is fragile: a %Capabilities{} struct makes every binary-dependent feature degrade BY DESIGN, and a wire-contract harness (fixture replay per PR + nightly real-binary smoke + pinned CLI version) turns 'the CLI updated and broke us' from an incident into a red test.

Leanings. (1) Wire-harness is the highest-EV slice and is never cut; fixture replay must reuse the frozen wave-10 fixtures and the six-file chat suite rather than invent a second corpus. (2) %Capabilities{} centralizes today's scattered binary-divergence knowledge (cmux Agent vs vanilla Task, missing TodoWrite, initialize response.commands) into one struct threaded through session_opts; the no-tax proof is a render-matrix test: identical transcript fixtures rendered pre/post-struct must produce byte-identical HTML. (3) MCP loopback: probe FIRST (scc-w12-mcp-probe gates the build) — real-binary proof that --mcp-config + --strict-mcp-config reaches bp mcp serve and tool calls round-trip on the stream-json wire; token = per-session ephemeral credential minted through the airdrop-grants seam, written to a per-spawn config file, revoked at session end; --strict-mcp-config so host MCP config never leaks in (precedent titles.ex:103). (4) Chips dispatch on OUR tool names (we own the loopback server — name-stable, unlike host tools per D38) and deep-link into the Studio routes the deep-link epic shipped. (5) Workday shell: needs-you strip aggregates the D31 needs-you set (approval/question/plan) + finished-while-away off last-result timestamps; notify is DOWNSTREAM of the strip (same signal, email transport via the existing Postfix/DKIM relay) and is the first thing cut if the wave overruns. (6) Fork probe is a written verdict in this Paper/charter, not UI — it re-opens D26 only if resumeSessionAt gives true message-granular rewind. Codex/ACP stay trigger-gated per /papers/provider-horizon rev 4 — zero provider-#2 scope this wave. Quality bar: Kinsta/Vercel — emitted tokens only, studio-literal-check green, honest degraded states everywhere.

   resolver Auth.verify_token/1 (auth.ex:27-53) reads ONLY api_tokens kind="api" — a Grant token can
   NEVER authenticate bp mcp serve. Built literally, the loopback fails silently. Correct design:
   authorize scope via the grants philosophy (Tenancy.Auth.authorize/3), MINT an ApiToken modeled on
   create_share_token/5 (auth.ex:433-469: opaque perms, no membership, scope string, clamped short
   TTL), REVOKE in ClaudeChat.Session terminate/2 (both clauses — the hook the grants surveyor
   couldn't find lives in claude_chat.ex:699-712, next to cleanup_stderr).

Goal: protect the moat (a %Capabilities{} struct with a no-tax matrix test proving Claude renders identically pre/post + a wire-contract harness: fixture replay per PR, nightly real-binary smoke, pinned CLI version), give Claude hands over Barkpark (MCP loopback via --mcp-config -> bp mcp serve with a session-scoped token through the grants seam, probe gates build; then task/paper/search results as deep-linked chips), and build the workday shell (needs-you/finished-while-away sidebar inbox strip, then email notifications via the existing Postfix/DKIM relay with deep links). Plus the fork-session probe: persist message.uuid, probe --resume+--fork-session and message-granular resumeSessionAt; deliverable is a written verdict, not UI. Demo sentence the wave must make true: I asked the chat to plan a feature; it wrote the Paper, filed the tasks, launched the epic-cycle, I watched the phases breathe in the rail — and it pinged me when it needed me.

The finished experience: the chat stops being a transcript viewer and becomes a coworker with hands and a pulse. You ask it to plan a feature; through its own MCP loopback into Barkpark it writes the Paper, files the tasks, launches the epic-cycle; the wave-11 rail shows the phases breathing; the sidebar's needs-you strip surfaces every pending question/plan/approval across ALL sessions plus what finished while you were away; and when you walk away, an email with a deep link brings you back to the exact card. Leanings. (1) Wire-harness is the highest-EV slice and is never cut; fixture replay must reuse the frozen wave-10 fixtures and the six-file chat suite rather than invent a second corpus. (2) %Capabilities{} centralizes today's scattered binary-divergence knowledge (cmux Agent vs vanilla Task, missing TodoWrite, initialize response.commands) into one struct threaded through session_opts; the no-tax proof is a render-matrix test: identical transcript fixtures rendered pre/post-struct must produce byte-identical HTML. Codex/ACP stay trigger-gated per /papers/provider-horizon rev 4 — zero provider-#2 scope this wave. The wish (verbatim)

Execute wave 12 of the studio-claude-chat initiative: "Claude's hands + the workday" — the 8 pre-filed bp children of epic task-9f81108b31d1d947 (scc-w12-capabilities, scc-w12-wire-harness, scc-w12-mcp-probe, scc-w12-mcp-loopback, scc-w12-native-chips, scc-w12-needs-you, scc-w12-notify, scc-w12-fork-probe). Goal: protect the moat (a %Capabilities{} struct with a no-tax matrix test proving Claude renders identically pre/post + a wire-contract harness: fixture replay per PR, nightly real-binary smoke, pinned CLI version), give Claude hands over Barkpark (MCP loopback via --mcp-config -> bp mcp serve with a session-scoped token through the grants seam, probe gates build; then task/paper/search results as deep-linked chips), and build the workday shell (needs-you/finished-while-away sidebar inbox strip, then email notifications via the existing Postfix/DKIM relay with deep links). Plus the fork-session probe: persist message.uuid, probe --resume+--fork-session and message-granular resumeSessionAt; deliverable is a written verdict, not UI. Demo sentence the wave must make true: I asked the chat to plan a feature; it wrote the Paper, filed the tasks, launched the epic-cycle, I watched the phases breathe in the rail — and it pinged me when it needed me.

Strategic direction (tentative — Decide finalizes)

The finished experience: the chat stops being a transcript viewer and becomes a coworker with hands and a pulse. You ask it to plan a feature; through its own MCP loopback into Barkpark it writes the Paper, files the tasks, launches the epic-cycle; the wave-11 rail shows the phases breathing; the sidebar's needs-you strip surfaces every pending question/plan/approval across ALL sessions plus what finished while you were away; and when you walk away, an email with a deep link brings you back to the exact card. Underneath, none of this is fragile: a %Capabilities{} struct makes every binary-dependent feature degrade BY DESIGN, and a wire-contract harness (fixture replay per PR + nightly real-binary smoke + pinned CLI version) turns 'the CLI updated and broke us' from an incident into a red test.

Leanings. (1) Wire-harness is the highest-EV slice and is never cut; fixture replay must reuse the frozen wave-10 fixtures and the six-file chat suite rather than invent a second corpus. (2) %Capabilities{} centralizes today's scattered binary-divergence knowledge (cmux Agent vs vanilla Task, missing TodoWrite, initialize response.commands) into one struct threaded through session_opts; the no-tax proof is a render-matrix test: identical transcript fixtures rendered pre/post-struct must produce byte-identical HTML. (5) Workday shell: needs-you strip aggregates the D31 needs-you set (approval/question/plan) + finished-while-away off last-result timestamps; notify is DOWNSTREAM of the strip (same signal, email transport via the existing Postfix/DKIM relay) and is the first thing cut if the wave overruns. (6) Fork probe is a written verdict in this Paper/charter, not UI — it re-opens D26 only if resumeSessionAt gives true message-granular rewind. Codex/ACP stay trigger-gated per /papers/provider-horizon rev 4 — zero provider-#2 scope this wave. Studio Claude Chat — Wave 12: Claude's hands + the workday

Living wave Paper. Epic: task-9f81108b31d1d947 (studio-chat-w12). Opened at Strategize 2026-07-10. Status: SURVEYING — 14 Sonnet surveyors in flight. Digest appends the survey fold + verify plan next; Decide appends decisions + the adopted/perfected task slate; Review closes the story.

The wish (verbatim)

Execute wave 12 of the studio-claude-chat initiative: "Claude's hands + the workday" — the 8 pre-filed bp children of epic task-9f81108b31d1d947 (scc-w12-capabilities, scc-w12-wire-harness, scc-w12-mcp-probe, scc-w12-mcp-loopback, scc-w12-native-chips, scc-w12-needs-you, scc-w12-notify, scc-w12-fork-probe). Goal: protect the moat (a %Capabilities{} struct with a no-tax matrix test proving Claude renders identically pre/post + a wire-contract harness: fixture replay per PR, nightly real-binary smoke, pinned CLI version), give Claude hands over Barkpark (MCP loopback via --mcp-config -> bp mcp serve with a session-scoped token through the grants seam, probe gates build; then task/paper/search results as deep-linked chips), and build the workday shell (needs-you/finished-while-away sidebar inbox strip, then email notifications via the existing Postfix/DKIM relay with deep links). Plus the fork-session probe: persist message.uuid, probe --resume+--fork-session and message-granular resumeSessionAt; deliverable is a written verdict, not UI. Demo sentence the wave must make true: I asked the chat to plan a feature; it wrote the Paper, filed the tasks, launched the epic-cycle, I watched the phases breathe in the rail — and it pinged me when it needed me.

Strategic direction (tentative — Decide finalizes)

The finished experience: the chat stops being a transcript viewer and becomes a coworker with hands and a pulse. You ask it to plan a feature; through its own MCP loopback into Barkpark it writes the Paper, files the tasks, launches the epic-cycle; the wave-11 rail shows the phases breathing; the sidebar's needs-you strip surfaces every pending question/plan/approval across ALL sessions plus what finished while you were away; and when you walk away, an email with a deep link brings you back to the exact card. Underneath, none of this is fragile: a %Capabilities{} struct makes every binary-dependent feature degrade BY DESIGN, and a wire-contract harness (fixture replay per PR + nightly real-binary smoke + pinned CLI version) turns 'the CLI updated and broke us' from an incident into a red test.

Leanings. (1) Wire-harness is the highest-EV slice and is never cut; fixture replay must reuse the frozen wave-10 fixtures and the six-file chat suite rather than invent a second corpus. (2) %Capabilities{} centralizes today's scattered binary-divergence knowledge (cmux Agent vs vanilla Task, missing TodoWrite, initialize response.commands) into one struct threaded through session_opts; the no-tax proof is a render-matrix test: identical transcript fixtures rendered pre/post-struct must produce byte-identical HTML. (3) MCP loopback: probe FIRST (scc-w12-mcp-probe gates the build) — real-binary proof that --mcp-config + --strict-mcp-config reaches bp mcp serve and tool calls round-trip on the stream-json wire; token = per-session ephemeral credential minted through the airdrop-grants seam, written to a per-spawn config file, revoked at session end; --strict-mcp-config so host MCP config never leaks in (precedent titles.ex:103). (4) Chips dispatch on OUR tool names (we own the loopback server — name-stable, unlike host tools per D38) and deep-link into the Studio routes the deep-link epic shipped. (5) Workday shell: needs-you strip aggregates the D31 needs-you set (approval/question/plan) + finished-while-away off last-result timestamps; notify is DOWNSTREAM of the strip (same signal, email transport via the existing Postfix/DKIM relay) and is the first thing cut if the wave overruns. (6) Fork probe is a written verdict in this Paper/charter, not UI — it re-opens D26 only if resumeSessionAt gives true message-granular rewind. Codex/ACP stay trigger-gated per /papers/provider-horizon rev 4 — zero provider-#2 scope this wave. Quality bar: Kinsta/Vercel — emitted tokens only, studio-literal-check green, honest degraded states everywhere.

Dependencies + cut order

mcp-probe GATES mcp-loopback GATES native-chips
needs-you GATES notify
capabilities | wire-harness | fork-probe : parallel-safe
cut order: notify first; NEVER the harness
Barkpark-coupled items this wave: loopback + chips (standing rule satisfied)

Survey plan (14 scouts, in flight)

1  claude-chat-args-seam   build_args/2 + session_opts threading + --strict-mcp-config precedent; where a per-spawn --mcp-config file lives/cleans. WHY: loopback lands here; D9 vacuous-green law applies.
2  bp-mcp-serve            what bp mcp serve exposes today (tools/resources/transport/auth), task_prime, Papers-as-resources. WHY: loopback's other half; decides tool vocabulary for chips.
3  grants-seam             minting a session-scoped ephemeral token from Elixir via the airdrop-grants/user-principal seam; TTL + revocation. WHY: the loopback credential design.
4  wire-fixtures           frozen wave-10 fixtures, six-file chat suite, claude-chat-e2e.sh, merge-gates CI shape. WHY: harness must reuse, not reinvent; per-PR + nightly lanes need homes.
5  capabilities-callsites  every site branching on binary features/version (cmux vs vanilla, initialize commands, init slash_commands). WHY: %Capabilities{} field list = this inventory.
6  render-notax            existing render/replay test helpers + seeds; how a pre/post render-identity matrix test would run. WHY: the no-tax proof is the capabilities acceptance criterion.
7  sidebar-inbox           sidebar today: pills, pending_approvals counter, needs_you vocabulary; focus/away signal; last-result timestamps. WHY: the strip's data is or isn't already there.
8  email-relay             how the API sends mail (relay config, DKIM, mailer lib), deep-link URL generation (PHX_HOST). WHY: notify rides existing rails or gets cut.
9  message-uuid            where message.uuid appears on the wire vs what Recorder persists; --fork-session/resumeSessionAt CLI ground truth. WHY: fork-probe scope + migration-or-metadata call.
10 mcp-wire                what stream-json emits for MCP tool calls (mcp__srv__tool names, blocks); D38 shape-dispatch seams in live+replay. WHY: chips hook here.
11 deep-links              Studio routes chips/emails need: task drill, /papers/:slug, search; what #1934-#1938 shipped. WHY: chip href contract.
12 task-ledger-w12         read all 8 children in full: criteria quality, evidence fields, missing deps. WHY: Decide adopts/perfects, never duplicates.
13 epic-cycle-launch       can chat launch an epic-cycle today (w9 plans->Papers, tmux console)? Is the wave-11 rail live-proven? WHY: the demo sentence's spine.

Survey digest (Digest phase, 2026-07-10)

14 surveyors returned, all with file:line evidence. The wave premise holds: the args seam, bp mcp serve, the fixture corpus, the mailer, and the D31 needs-you set are all real and ready-shaped. But the survey surfaced five corrections that Decide MUST bake into the task briefs before builders fly — one of them (the grants seam) would have caused a silent auth failure if built as written.

Established (anchored)

MOAT
- build_args/2 (claude_chat.ex:117) is the pure argv seam; stderr_path (:722-729) is the per-session
  temp-file + both-terminate/2-teardown pattern to clone for the mcp-config JSON. D9 test shape =
  pure build_args units + :binary argv-echo (claude_chat_test.exs:495-529, 911-963).
- titles.ex:103 is a FALSE FRIEND: --strict-mcp-config is used ALONE there (hermetic zero-MCP one-shot).
  No file in the repo ever pairs it with a real --mcp-config. The pairing is greenfield.
- Fixture replay per PR is ALREADY FREE: bare `mix test` on every PR runs the six-FILE chat suite
  (charter L1338; 488 tests, 0 failures at seed 37 re-run today — grown from wave-10's 453).
  Fixtures = 5 ndjson (3 frozen wave-10 + 2 wave-11), NOT six — 'six' counts test files.
- Nightly lane + CLI version pin DO NOT EXIST (2 crons repo-wide, both unrelated; zero version checks
  in code — v2.1.205 appears only in comments). GH-hosted runners can't host it (interactive OAuth);
  guerrilla can: authenticated claude 2.1.206, autoUpdates:false, empty crontab.
- No %Capabilities{} struct, no version detection anywhere. All binary divergence lives in 3 files:
  chat_tool_renderer.ex (Agent/Task, MultiEdit; D38/D40), studio_chat.ex:492-505 (todo_shaped?),
  claude_chat.ex:390-402 + recorder.ex:247-287,822-878 (initialize ack / slash_commands fallback).
- Render no-tax mechanism exists to transplant: email_golden_test.exs (assert html == golden,
  @external_resource, regen-in-same-diff doctrine) + canvas parity gate, both CI-blocking via plain
  mix test. Obstacles: chat row renderers are defp inside the LiveView (message_body :1479,
  rail_entry :2631, + unchecked components at :1751/:2683/:2726/:4973) and DateTime.utc_now leaks
  into session_stamp (:4901-4915) — promotion-to-public + time-freeze are real prerequisites.

HANDS
- bp mcp serve: stdio-only (mcp_serve.go:120), curated six task tools default (incl. task_prime),
  Papers as MCP resources, generic bp_<noun>_<verb> bridge under --tools all. Auth = plain
  BARKPARK_API_TOKEN env — mechanically ready for a scoped token, but NOTHING wires grants to it.
- search.query surfaces ONLY under --tools all (not curated, not shadowed) — the chips' search leg
  needs a 7th curated tool or --tools all. Decide picks.
- No fixture anywhere captures a real MCP tool_use/tool_result — MCP wire shape is UNPROVEN;
  mcp-probe is correctly positioned as the gate. Chip hooks: ONE classify seam (chat_tool_renderer),
  consumed identically by live append (chat_live.ex:1030-1051) and replay (:3624-3648).

WORKDAY
- D31 needs-you widening (approval/question/plan) is DONE (studio_chat.ex:205-213). Ingredients for
  the strip exist (pending_approvals counter, D29 transient PubSub activity on studio_chat:activity);
  cross-session aggregation, finished-while-away persistence, and ANY away/focus signal do NOT.
  chat_sessions has no user_id at all — 'away' will be an inferred design decision, not a discovery.
- Email send path is turnkey: Swoosh + SMTP (runtime.exs:427-479), GrantNotifier is the copy-paste
  template (access/grant_notifier.ex, deep link via Endpoint.url() — #1190 lesson honored).
  The SEAM (opt-out, debounce, aggregation) is the real scope of notify; sending is ~free.

FORK PROBE
- The wire id is a TOP-LEVEL `uuid` on EVERY frame (sibling of `message` — message.uuid does not
  exist). Recorder persists nothing off it today (grep: zero hits); capture = metadata-only jsonb
  key, no migration. --resume and --fork-session are real on 2.1.206; resumeSessionAt is NOT a CLI
  flag — it is t3.chat app-level bookkeeping (bp-studio-chat-t3-patterns.md:44-46). The probe must
  reframe: 'is fork-from-head + our uuid-keyed log good enough', not 'test resumeSessionAt'.

Corrections to the direction (Decide must bake these in)

   authorize scope via the grants philosophy (Tenancy.Auth.authorize/3), MINT an ApiToken modeled on
   create_share_token/5 (auth.ex:433-469: opaque perms, no membership, scope string, clamped short

   Papers + search, and the rail has NEVER been seen against a live run (charter:2107-2108 admits
   it). Decide must either add a launch-probe slice or honestly narrow the demo to the
   Paper-written + tasks-filed + chips + ping half.
3. VERSION SKEW: fixtures were captured on 2.1.205; every host (local + guerrilla) now runs 2.1.206.
